Eye Pattern - Cybernetic Irises.description:
👁️ Eye Pattern: Cybernetic Irises
Irises with visible mechanical structures — circuits, rings, or interface elements replacing natural eye anatomy.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Eye Pattern - Cybernetic Irises.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: Both irises have a mechanical cybernetic structure — visible segmented rings, aperture patterns, or digital geometry within the iris. Apply cybernetic iris detail using selected eye colors. Do not turn this into active power use.

Visual selection only: keep the character's actual adult age, body plan and any Mutant features; never change anatomy to fit this choice. It adds no Quirk effect, injury, item, license or affiliation.
